2025

Participated in a press conference at the UNFCCC June Climate Meetings in Bonn for the "Indicators of Global Climate Change 2024" publication (19/06) [link]

Contributed to an Informal Dialogue at the UNFCCC June Climate Meetings on 1.5C science and narratives (19/06) [link]

Invited expert to the 17th Meeting of the Research Dialogue, UNFCCC June Climate Meetings - though really Pep Canadell did all the work! (17/06)

Interviewed by Südwestrundfunk and tagesschau.de on the "Indicators of Global Climate Change 2024" publication (17/06) [link]

Interviewed by ARD for a piece on greenhouse gas emissions reporting (16/06)

Participated in a UK Science Media Centre Briefing for the "Indicators of Global Climate Change 2024" publication (12/06)

Interviewed for an article in DeSmog on the topic of Climate Delay (11/06)

Invited to present Discourses of Climate Delay at a GIZ event on Behavioural Change (27/03)

Inited to present on the IPCC 7th Assessment Report outline by the German-IPCC coordination group (20/03)

2024

Nominated to attend the IPCC Scoping Meeting for the 7th Assessment Report (09/12)

Participated in the preparation of evidence submitted by IPCC authors to the International Court of Justice for their case on the "legal obligations of countries in preventing climate change" (26/11) [photo!]

Invited to present to the European Commission DG Clima division on the Emissions Gap Report 2024 (07/11)

Invited to present to the US Office of the Special Presidential Envoy for Climate on the Emissions Gap Report 2024 (31/10)

2023

Invited to a roundtable on climate misinformation with the Chief Scientific Advisor to the UK Government (21/06)
